## Product

<!-- Which product does this concern? Name it and the version tested. -->

## Vulnerability

<!-- The weakness, in one or two sentences: the type (for example stored XSS,
     CWE-79), the privilege it needs, and the component it lives in. -->

## Affected versions

<!-- The range you tested against, and the latest release you confirmed. -->

## Severity

<!-- The CVSS 3.1 score and the vector, or why the score is an estimate. -->

## Disclosed

<!-- When the vendor was told, and how. If the vendor has not been told yet,
     say so plainly -- do not open a public write-up before disclosure. -->

## Lab reproduction

<!-- The steps, at the level of detail a reader needs to understand the
     mechanism. Reproduce on a local install with test accounts only. -->

## Proposal

<!-- What you would like added or changed. For a new advisory: the file you
     would add and the sections it would contain. For a structural change:
     what the repository should do differently and why. -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Other approaches, and why this one fits better. -->

## Authorised-use note

<!-- Confirm the finding was reproduced on a local lab and that no third-party
     site was tested, and that the vendor was contacted before publication. -->
